description: Add browser regression tests with a 3-second JWT renewed before a 5-second mock answer, plus a 3-second delayed mock error; validate actual widget rendering.

comments.text: Added two real-browser regressions and test-only asynchronous delayed host replies. Chromium: renewal scenario fails only at answer visibility after successful parent renewal; 3-second error scenario passes. Temporary 5-second reply control without renewal passes; removed control file. Existing shared-widget Chromium tests pass. mix assets.build passes; mix precommit passes (157 tests). No production changes. Tests intentionally retain expected success assertion to expose delivery bug.

title: Test delayed responses across JWT renewal and delayed errors
